-- Ran hosted API trial (Nov-Dec). Beta exposed to 2k weekly active beta users.
-- Trial concrete metrics: avg 12 QPS steady during business hours, typical burst to 45 QPS for short periods (demo events). Peak concurrency measured 120 concurrent chat sessions during product demo events.
-- Token profile (observed): 70% short responses (<80 tokens), 25% medium (80-512), 5% long (>512). Average tokens per API call ~140.
-- Latency targets: product team wants p95 generation <= 120ms for chat when using low-latency model; p99 <= 300ms preferred.
-- Cost sensitivity: CFO asking for unit economics: target < $0.0009/token averaged across workload; optimizing for batching + prefix cache.
-- Requirements: must support VPC peering for Dedicated, SSO (Okta SAML), audit logs for all inference requests, KMS integration for key wrapping, 7y retention policy on audit metadata (legal asks).
-- Quote from CTO: "We prefer predictable capacity and clear failure modes — if host capacity constrained we need automated fallback to a cheaper variant without user-visible failures."
-- POC focus for Dedicated sizing: map QPS->instance count under 90 token avg generation, estimate KV cache hit rate (expect 8% strong prefix reuse), test continuous batching at 50-200ms windows.
-- Links: pricing deck + sizing worksheet in Drive, security FAQ link requested (send to security@).
